content: Fire and Emergency New Zealand @FireEmergencyNZ Jan 25, 2024 Preparedness is an important way we can protect ourselves, our whānau, and our homes from emergencies. Download the MetService New Zealand app and turn on notifications to be the first to know when the fire danger is extreme or there’s a severe weather warning in your area 🔥⛈ MetService NZ @MetService Jan 25, 2024 🔔 Notifications are here! Be prepared for Aotearoa New Zealand's most extreme conditions. Red Severe Weather Warnings and Extreme Fire Danger notifications are now available in MetService NZ Weather app. Don't have the app? Get it here 👉about.metservice.com/our-apps
